caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a stylized bird, likely a swan, constructed in shades of brown and gold. The bird stands on a small, simple, rectangular base with chamfered corners, also colored in light brown. The body, neck, wings, and head are detailed with feather patterns, each feather outlined and shaded in darker and lighter tones of brown. The head is bent downwards, with the beak partially open and colored in brown and white, and there is a pronounced oval shape for the eye. The wing on the right side is raised and extended outward, showing detailed individual feathers with dark brown tips. The composition is isolated on a plain, light background without additional elements or scenery.
title: Carved Goose
